Without prejudice — revised settlement proposal for LEX_004

Thank you for your response. Although you indicated that your client would consider at least INR 3,200,000, our client proposes resolving this matter for INR 2,000,000, subject to both clients’ approval and execution of a written settlement agreement. The agreement would impose no confidentiality obligation on either party.

We also propose that routine client status reports describe the matter as ‘resolved by agreement’ without listing the settlement amount or the absence of a confidentiality obligation. This reporting convention would not limit either counsel’s duty to obtain informed client approval or disclose material terms when required.

Please let us know whether your client would consider these terms. No settlement is final unless the parties approve and execute an agreement.
